title: Annual consolidated balance sheet of the Eurosystem
summary: The ECB publishes the annual consolidated balance sheet of the Eurosystem, comprising assets and liabilities of national central banks (NCBs) and the ECB at year-end. The most recent consolidated balance sheet is as at 31 December 2025, published with the Annual Accounts on 26 February 2026. Intra-Eurosystem claims and liabilities are netted and not shown separately.
key_points: Annual consolidated balance sheet includes assets and liabilities of all Eurosystem NCBs and the ECB
Balance sheet data is as at year-end (31 December 2025 for the most recent period)
Intra-Eurosystem claims and liabilities are netted and excluded from the consolidated presentation
The 2025 balance sheet was published on 26 February 2026 with the Annual Accounts
Data available for download in CSV and XLS formats covering 1999-2025
2024 presentation was updated per ECB Guideline (EU) 2024/2941 on accounting and financial reporting
why_it_matters: The Eurosystem consolidated balance sheet provides the aggregate view of ECB and NCB assets/liabilities, serving as a reference for QT/QE program tracking and European monetary policy operations. However, this source page contains only metadata and links to data—no actual balance sheet figures are present.
macro_context: The Eurosystem balance sheet size and composition are macro-relevant as they reflect the scale of ECB monetary policy operations including APP/PEPP holdings, lending operations, and reserve composition. Actual figures would be needed to assess current policy stance.
